title: RNA meets protein decay
level: Researchers (students, postdocs, academic and industry participants)
about: EMBO Workshop "RNA meets protein decay" takes place in Fürstenfeldbruck, Germany, from 3 to 6 May 2027. Registration and abstract submission close on 1 March 2027; abstracts are selected for short talks or posters.
